introduction: A slab leak is a plumbing leak that occurs in pipes located beneath a property's concrete foundation.
Because these leaks develop below the surface, they can remain hidden and cause serious water damage if not identified early.
Houston homeowners can benefit from understanding slab leak warning signs, detection methods and repair options.

sections.title: What Is A Slab Leak?
sections.subtitle: Understanding underground foundation plumbing leaks
content: A slab leak occurs when a water pipe beneath a concrete foundation develops a crack, break or damaged section.
These plumbing leaks can affect the foundation area, flooring and surrounding property structures.
Professional slab leak detection helps locate the affected pipe and determine the appropriate repair method.
sections.highlight: Early slab leak detection can help reduce water damage and prevent larger foundation-related problems.

sections.title: Common Causes of Slab Leaks in Houston TX
sections.subtitle: Why underground pipes develop leaks
content: Slab leaks can occur due to pipe age, corrosion, pressure issues, soil movement and plumbing system conditions.
Identifying the cause of a slab leak helps professionals choose the correct repair solution.

causes.title: Aging Plumbing Pipes
causes.description: Older pipes may weaken over time and develop cracks or leaks beneath foundations.

causes.title: Corrosion
causes.description: Pipe corrosion can create weak areas that eventually lead to underground leaks.

causes.title: High Water Pressure
causes.description: Excessive pressure can place stress on plumbing lines and connections.

causes.title: Ground Movement
causes.description: Soil changes and foundation movement may affect underground plumbing systems.

faqs.question: What is a slab leak?
faqs.answer: A slab leak is a plumbing leak that occurs in pipes located beneath a concrete foundation.

faqs.question: What are common signs of a slab leak?
faqs.answer: Common signs include higher water bills, warm floors, damp areas, running water sounds and unexplained moisture.

faqs.question: How are slab leaks detected?
faqs.answer: Professional providers may use electronic detection, pressure testing, thermal inspection and other diagnostic methods.

faqs.question: Can slab leaks damage a foundation?
faqs.answer: Untreated slab leaks may contribute to water damage and create additional plumbing or property concerns.

faqs.question: What repair options are available for slab leaks?
faqs.answer: Repair options depend on the leak location and may include pipe repair, replacement, rerouting or other professional solutions.
